content: Alice Smith and I decided to use PostgreSQL over MySQL for the new Grove backend. Alice felt strongly that pgvector support was the deciding factor.
We need to migrate the prototype SQLite data to PostgreSQL next sprint.
Caught up with Priya Nair at PyCon. She's leading the ML infra team at Stripe now.
Met Dr. Lisa Park at the AI in Healthcare conference. She runs the clinical NLP lab at Stanford.
Networked with Yuki Tanaka from OpenAI DevRel at the Hackathon.
Dentist appointment with Dr. Chen on Thursday at 2pm for a routine cleaning.
Annual performance review with my manager Sarah is scheduled for next Friday morning.
Decided to switch the local-inference stack from cloud OpenAI embeddings to a self-hosted bge-m3 model running on Ollama, mainly for cost and privacy reasons.
